status_definitions.SUPPORTED_ENGINE_VERIFIED: A pinned real ocgcore fixture has emitted the relevant interactive decision, OCGForge exposed it correctly, a valid semantic response was selected and encoded, ocgcore accepted it, and execution continued without retry/protocol failure.
status_definitions.SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERIFIED: The parser, legal candidate generation, continuation semantics, response encoder, and isolated/property/oracle tests are verified, but no actual pinned-core fixture has yet proven the full decision path.
status_definitions.UNSUPPORTED_FAIL_CLOSED: The decision family is recognized as unsupported and fails closed without guessing or silently selecting an action.
status_definitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE_M1: The decision family is intentionally outside the M1/M1.1 scope and is not counted as supported coverage.

messages.request_structure: No writer found in the pinned OCG core; legacy protocol placeholder.
messages.response_structure: Not established by the pinned core.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: No pinned-core writer or controlled fixture.
known_edge_cases: Do not invent a deck response for a message the pinned core does not emit.
source_evidence: no MSG_REQUEST_DECK writer found in pinned ocgcore sources

messages.request_structure: player; activatable card records; attackable card records; to-M2 and to-EP flags.
messages.response_structure: int32 command/index packed as low/high 16-bit fields.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M0 controlled lifecycle reaches typed decisions; no M1 change.
known_edge_cases: Duplicate display cards remain distinct by physical locator.

messages.request_structure: player; summon/special-summon/reposition/set/activation card lists; phase flags.
messages.response_structure: int32 command/index packed as low/high 16-bit fields.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M0 controlled duel and deterministic probe.
messages.unit_protocol_coverage: Existing decoder, candidate uniqueness, and response tests.
known_edge_cases: Wire list entry sizes differ between reposition and other card lists.

messages.request_structure: player; card code/location; effect description.
messages.response_structure: int32 0 or 1.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M1.1 select-option scenario emits the effect-yes/no prompt, accepts yes, and continues to the option decision.
known_edge_cases: Card identity is visible only as supplied by the engine message.

messages.request_structure: player; effect description.
messages.response_structure: int32 0 or 1.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M0 protocol path; no continuation required.
known_edge_cases: Do not auto-select one branch.

messages.request_structure: player; uint8 option count; one uint64 engine option payload per ordinal.
messages.response_structure: int32 option ordinal.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M1.1 pinned fixture emits two distinct option ordinals and accepts one exact ordinal response.
messages.unit_protocol_coverage: M1 option preservation and duplicate-payload tests.
known_edge_cases: Count is uint8 on the wire; duplicate payloads must not collapse.

messages.request_structure: player; cancelable; uint32 min/max; uint32 count; code plus loc_info per selectable card.
messages.response_structure: card response: int32 encoding type, count, and selected source indices; -1 for cancel when allowed.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M1.1 pinned fixture selects two of two real candidates with min one and max two, then accepts one final indexed response.
known_edge_cases: min may be zero
min may differ from max
no fixed candidate cap
physical copies need locators

messages.request_structure: player; special count; forced flag; hint timings; chain card/effect records.
messages.response_structure: int32 chain ordinal or -1 when not forced.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M0 protocol decoder; no M1 change.
known_edge_cases: Pass is not legal when forced.

messages.request_structure: player; uint8 zone count; uint32 disabled/occupied zone bit mask.
messages.response_structure: count repetitions of controller, location, sequence (3 bytes each).
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M0 pinned fixture proves the count-one response path; no stable count-greater-than-one fixture was needed to establish the family contract.
known_edge_cases: Own and opponent zones use different flag ranges
MZONE and SZONE sequence widths differ

messages.request_structure: player; card code; allowed position bit mask.
messages.response_structure: int32 selected position bit.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M0 protocol path.
known_edge_cases: Only the four position bits are legal.

messages.request_structure: player; cancelable; uint32 min/max; uint32 count; code, controller, location, sequence, release_param per card.
messages.response_structure: card index response identical to select-card; core checks weighted release_param and adjusted max.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M1 Windows VIP Whale fixture emits MSG_SELECT_TRIBUTE; indexed final response accepted after adapter-local continuation.
known_edge_cases: release_param is the contribution
core caps max at five before writing the message
cancel is allowed when cancelable or min is zero

messages.request_structure: player; uint32 count; code, controller, location, sequence per chain item.
messages.response_structure: one int8 source index per item, a permutation.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M1 ordering fixture pending.
known_edge_cases: Do not deduplicate permutations
-1 is an engine-recognized bypass but is not auto-selected by OCGForge

messages.request_structure: player; uint16 counter type; uint16 required amount; uint32 count; code/location/max counter per card.
messages.response_structure: one signed int16 allocation per listed card; allocations must sum exactly to required amount.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M1.1 pinned fixture exposes two capacity-one cards, preserves zero allocation as a candidate, and accepts the final 0,1 allocation.
known_edge_cases: Zero allocation is a real choice
single-card allocation is resolved by the core before message emission
no automatic distribution

messages.request_structure: player; mode; target; min/max; mandatory count/items; optional count/items; each item has sum_param with one or two uint16 values.
messages.response_structure: card index response over optional items; mandatory items are implicit.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M1.1 pinned fixture exposes the real target/mode and positive contribution values, then accepts a valid multi-item response.
known_edge_cases: mode 0 is exact reachability
mode 1 is greater-sum semantics
mandatory items are not response indices
sum_param may encode two values

messages.request_structure: player; uint8 zone count; uint32 field-disabled bit mask; same wire shape as select-place.
messages.response_structure: count repetitions of controller, location, sequence (3 bytes each).
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M1.1 pinned fixture emits two distinct typed zones and accepts the exact controller/location/sequence response.
known_edge_cases: Use the same typed zone primitives as select-place
do not treat the response as an opaque integer

messages.request_structure: player; uint32 count; code, controller, location, sequence per card.
messages.response_structure: one int8 source index per card, a permutation.
messages.engine_fixture_coverage: M1.1 pinned fixture exposes source indices 0,1,2, shrinks the ordered domain after each pick, and accepts the final order.
